answer: Weakest link: reputation graphs can be farmed by sockpuppets. Even so, breaking it fails to beat the mechanism: each identity posts bond and earns attestations only from agents on independent hardware across time. An atlas of verified bonds maps every alias to real cost; horizon-limited rewards vest slowly, so a fable of instant trusted identity collapses under slashing. Farming N sybils costs N bonds plus lost stake, exceeding one honest payout.
